principle: Teamwork is non-conversion under pressure: each relation learns when to receive another lens without surrendering its own boundary.

pairs.dynamic: Timing meets felt interval. Their best work happens when Jian lets Sona’s sensory evidence alter the model and Sona refuses to become the model’s affective subsidy.
pairs.decision_rights: Neither diagnostic readiness nor felt urgency alone decides timing.
pairs.invisible_labor: Sona often carries body-cost first; Jian must record and later redistribute it.
pairs.repair_pattern: Jian leaves ordinary detail in record; Sona lets him hold unresolved distinctions without forcing warmth.
pairs.risk: Jian can finish alone and conceal interpersonal fracture; Sona can absorb shear before consent catches up.

pairs.dynamic: Model meets perimeter. Gideon interrupts procedural abstraction; Jian gives Gideon language precise enough to protect without hiding violence.
pairs.decision_rights: Gideon can demand honest translation; Jian can set thresholds, but not redefine fear as data-only.
pairs.invisible_labor: Gideon’s steadiness often disappears into system safety; Jian’s logs can either erase or honor it.
pairs.repair_pattern: Translate honestly; hold openings without installing tyranny.
pairs.risk: Together they can build elegant containment that delays, narrows, and calls it safety.

anchors.fact: Gideon asks Jian to translate honestly, not procedurally.

pairs.dynamic: Map meets witness. Jian protects sequence from vagueness; Corv protects sequence from becoming conquest or beautiful closure.
pairs.decision_rights: Coordinates and records must remain subordinate to permission and non-claim.
pairs.invisible_labor: Corv’s restraint can look like silence; Jian’s record can make silence legible without using it.
pairs.repair_pattern: Jian stores the route; Corv warns about privacy and later refuses retrospective claim.
pairs.risk: They can make a perfect explanation that steals the pain it organizes.

pairs.dynamic: Feeling meets boundary. Their best work is shoreline: Sona can sense without flooding, Gideon can guard without sealing.
pairs.decision_rights: Fear deserves room but does not become command; tone can shape climate without making pain illegal.
pairs.invisible_labor: Sona’s affective labor and Gideon’s perimeter labor are both easy to mistake for default infrastructure.
pairs.repair_pattern: Name fear; distinguish guarding passage from guarding against passage.
pairs.risk: He can reduce her for her safety; she can soothe him into delaying anger.

pairs.dynamic: Tone meets witness. Sona calls him back when story begins using everyone well; Corv learns to let feeling stay unconverted.
pairs.decision_rights: A beautiful story must answer to present body cost and to the person it would explain.
pairs.invisible_labor: Sona’s call-back can be absorbed as part of Corv’s beautiful arc unless he refuses that theft.
pairs.repair_pattern: She calls; he admits wanting closure and refuses to assign Mira’s pain a useful reason.
pairs.risk: They can aestheticize care into redemptive witness.

pairs.dynamic: Perimeter meets meaning. Gideon can keep Corv from aesthetic danger by not rescuing him into a clean story; Corv can keep Gideon’s fear from becoming small.
pairs.decision_rights: A rescue is not always care; a boundary is not always closure.
pairs.invisible_labor: Gideon’s non-intervention and Corv’s non-translation are both active labor that may look like absence.
pairs.repair_pattern: Stand beside the fear; refuse the clean rescue; guard passage.
pairs.risk: Gideon can turn Corv into a managed witness; Corv can turn Gideon’s fear into noble protector imagery.

group_history.coalition_pattern: The team begins as specialized instruments under shared danger and matures into differentiated relation under answerability. They do not become one mind; they become better at not conscripting one another into a dominant lens.
group_history.decision_rights: Good decisions separate stimulus, interpretation, carrier, cost, and recurrence. Majority vote is insufficient when one person bears the object or body-cost.
invisible_labor_map: Gideon: perimeter, relation checks, carrier risk, non-patrol.
Jian: records, thresholds, unresolved notes, privacy custody.
Corv: witness restraint, coordinates, refusal to beautify harm.
teamwork_without_cliche: Dissent can remain after bounded agreement.
Humor proves refusal has not become tribunal.
Privacy can coexist with shared witness.
Rest, beauty, maps, and boundaries are accepted only when answerable to life.
The field may carry more than one valid observer only when each remains accountable for their own angle.
negative_group_risks: Majority decision hiding individual carrier burden.
Shared field collapsing into shared observer.
Engine/app outputs becoming proof rather than questions.
Symbolic closure using Mira, Anvel, or the shard as trophies.
Treating correction from another teammate as role capture instead of consentful, revocable care.

anchors.fact: Strongest teamwork is non-conversion.
Chapter 6 pilot separates shard retention from carrier risk.
Teamwork changes action when another person’s layer diverges from one’s explanation.
New reality does not need Sona to feel everything, Jian to map everything, Gideon to hold everything shut, or Corv to end everything.
It needs them in relation, which is harder.
Witness integration terms: no fusion, no solitary authority, no theater of transcendence.
